 svt_sequence_item  svt_sequence_item  trace [$] Trace of any transactions of the same type that were created as a result of processing this transaction (e.g., due to retries, etc.). If enable_trace defined to return 0, then only contains 'last' traced transaction. If enable_trace defined to return 1, then contains all traced transactions. Elements are added to this list via calls to store_trace.

The function returns 0 and the output is unpredictable if Xs and Zs are passed in via the argument. Following rules are followed while implementing this function: 1) The LFSR implements the polynomial: G(X)=X^16+X^5+X^4+X^3+1 2) There is no resetting of the LFSR under any condition.

 svt_mipi_dsi_packet  constraint  valid_ranges 
valid constraint range for DSI packets fields. max_packet_delay shall be greater than min_packet_delay. Value of packet_delay shall be inside the range of min_packet_delay and max_packet_delay. For FORWARD packet, reverse_data_id field shall be RESERVED_RESP. For REVERSE packet, forward_data_id field shall be RESERVED and transmission mode will either be LPDT or TRIGGER. bta_active will either be 2'b00 or 2'b01. If bta_enable is 0, then bta_active is always 0. For SHORT packet and LONG packet, forward_data_id and reverse_data_id should be as per specification. data_word_count field: For EOTP packet, data_word_count shall be 16'h0F0F. If forward_data_id field inside VSYNC_START, VSYNC_END, HSYNC_START, HSYNC_END, COLOR_MODE_OFF, COLOR_MODE_ON, SHUT_DOWN, TURN_ON, GEN_WRITE0, GEN_READ0 then data_word_count shall be 00. If forward_data_id field inside GEN_READ1, GEN_WRITE1, DCS_WRITE0 and DCS_READ0 then upper byte of data_word_count (data_word_count[15:8]) shall be 00. If forward_data_id is DCS_WRITE0 then lower byte of data_word_count (data_word_count[7:0]) shall be inside ENTER_IDLE_MODE, ENTER_INVERT_MODE, ENTER_PARTIAL_MODE, ENTER_NORMAL_MODE, ENTER_SLEEP_MODE, EXIT_IDLE_MODE, EXIT_INVERT_MODE, EXIT_SLEEP_MODE, NOP, SET_DISPLAY_OFF, SET_DISPLAY_ON, SET_TEAR_OFF, SOFT_RESET. If forward_data_id is DCS_WRITE0 then lower byte of data_word_count (data_word_count[7:0]) shall be inside SET_ADDRESS_MODE, SET_GAMMA_CURVE, SET_PIXEL_FORMAT, SET_TEAR_ON. If forward_data_id is DCS_READ0 then lower byte of data_word_count (data_word_count[7:0]) shall be inside GET_BLUE_CHANNEL, GET_ADDRESS_MODE, GET_DIAGNOSTIC_RESULT, GET_DISPLAY_MODE, GET_GREEN_CHANNEL, GET_PIXEL_FORMAT, GET_POWER_MODE, GET_RED_CHANNEL, GET_SCAN_LINE, GET_SIGNAL_MODE, READ_DDB_START, READ_DDB_CONTINUE, READ_MEMORY_START, READ_MEMORY_CONTINUE, GET_3D_CONTROL, GET_IMAGE_CHECKSUM_RGB. If forward_data_id is PACKED_PIXEL_565 then data_word_count shall be in multiple of 2. If forward_data_id is PACKED_PIXEL_666 then data_word_count shall be in multiple of 9. If forward_data_id is either PACKED_PIXEL_888 or LOOSELY_PACKED_PIXEL_666 then data_word_count shall be in multiple of 3. For ULPM and TRIGGER transmission mode below fields have fixed value. packet_kind == SHORT data_word_count == 16'h0 ecc_value == 8'h0 crc_value == 16'h0 forward_data_id == RESERVED reverse_data_id == RESERVED_RESP packet_type == NORMAL
